build_hubert_model: build a HubertModel instance from HubertConfig and HubertPretrainingTask for speech pretraining
run_forward_hubert: run the HubertModel forward pass with source audio and target labels to compute NCE logits
extract_features_hubert: extract features from audio source using HubertModel extract_features with optional masking
apply_mask_hubert: apply temporal and channel masking to HubertModel encoder input features during pretraining
remove_pretraining_modules_hubert: remove pretraining modules from HubertModel to prepare for downstream fine-tuning tasks
